As a logistics employee in Eindhoven, you work at a large logistics company. You sort packages in the afternoon or at night. You work at least 12 hours per week. You choose which days you work. The working hours are fixed: afternoon shift from 4:00 PM to 2:00 AM and night shift from 2:30 AM to 7:00 AM. This work is physically demanding, as you lift packages between 5 and 20 kilos. You sort and stack these packages on pallets or in cages.
On a workday, you start by scanning packages. Then you place them on the conveyor belt. At the end of the belt, you remove them from the chutes. After that, you stack them neatly. You make sure everything happens safely and quickly. Together with your colleagues, you keep up the pace. Every day brings enough variety and you work with modern tools.
This is the job for you if you like to stay active and want to work in the evening or at night. You earn a good salary with bonuses. The atmosphere is open and you get clear instructions. Apply quickly if you are strong and ready to work hard! 💪

- You are at least 18 years old

- You have (pre-)vocational education level

- You speak Dutch or English

- You can safely handle heavy packages

- You enjoy working in a team and get things done

- You are available for at least 12 hours per week

- Experience in logistics is a plus, but not required

Are you an experienced Order Picker looking for a new challenge in logistics? Then we have a great opportunity for you.

As an Order Picker, you are responsible for collecting and processing orders using a hand scanner. You will operate an EPT daily and ensure that orders are picked accurately, completed on time, and prepared for shipment. In addition, you will check incoming and outgoing goods and help keep warehouse locations organised and efficient.

You will work with a modern warehouse management system where logistics processes are accurately recorded. Thanks to your attention to detail, orders are processed correctly and inventory data remains up to date. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that daily warehouse operations run smoothly and customers receive their orders on time.

You will work in different warehouse zones, including chilled areas and freezer sections with temperatures of up to -15°C. You are comfortable working in a temperature-controlled environment where quality, speed, and food safety are essential. Professional protective clothing will be provided to ensure you can work safely and comfortably.

Working hours take place between 07:00 and 00:00. You will join a dedicated team where teamwork, reliability, and a positive attitude are highly valued. Your contribution plays an important role in keeping the logistics operation running efficiently.

Ready for a new challenge in logistics? Apply now and discover what this opportunity can offer you.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Experience with order picking using a hand scanner and EPT is required
- You work accurately, safely, and have a strong focus on quality
- You are a team player with a proactive attitude
- You are comfortable working in chilled and frozen environments

This creates a dynamic period with many opportunities. That is why Manpower is looking for extra Warehouse Workers who want to join the team and help keep the operation running smoothly. If you enjoy active work and want to develop your skills, this is a great moment to step in!

Your tasks as a Warehouse Worker

    - Picking and preparing orders
    
- Sorting incoming goods
    
- Scanning products with a hand scanner
    
- Entering data into warehouse systems
    
- Supporting general warehouse and packaging tasks
    
- Working with warehouse equipment; a forklift or HOPT license is a strong advantage

What's in it for you

    - Full‑time job (40 hours per week)
    
- Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Travel allowance up to €14.85 per day
    
- 35% shift allowance after 21:00
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Training options through the Manpower Academy (for example VCA)

    - Own transport (location not reachable by public transport during shifts)
    
- Minimum age: 18 years
    
- Strong English communication skills (important for safety and teamwork)
    
- Physically able to lift, walk and stand

- Able to provide a VOG
    
- Warehouse experience preferred; forklift or HOPT license is a big plus
